nodes.description: UniFarmAdminStorage.admin - administrator address guarding privileged proxy functions.
UniFarmAdminStorage.pendingAdmin - intermediate storage slot for two-step admin handover.
UniFarmAdminStorage.wanFarmImplementation - delegatecall target holding the logic of the farm.
UniFarmAdminStorage.pendingWanFarmImplementation - intermediate slot for two-step implementation handover.
WanFarmV1Storage.poolInfo - array of PoolInfo structs holding LP token accounting and accrued reward per share.
WanFarmV1Storage.userInfo - nested mapping of per-user amount, rewardDebt and extRewardDebt.
Immutable IERC20 reference to the wanWan reward token distributed to users.
Untrusted caller address controlling authorization checks, deposits, withdrawals and token transfers.
UniFarm payable fallback that delegatecalls all calldata into wanFarmImplementation.
Admin-only setter staging a new implementation address; reverts logically on unauthorized caller.
Accepts the pending implementation; caller must equal pendingWanFarmImplementation.
Admin-only setter staging a new pending admin address.
Accepts pending admin role; caller must equal pendingAdmin.
WanFarm function that binds to a new UniFarm brain; requires msg.sender == uniFarm.admin().
Public deposit of LP tokens; pays pending wanWan to msg.sender before finalising accounting.
Public withdrawal of LP tokens; pays pending wanWan before reducing user amount and currentSupply.
Admin-only emergency exit that force-withdraws the pool from the external sushi farm.
Admin-only function sweeping residual wanWan after all bonus periods expire.
Admin-only function transferring unclaimed-award surplus of the external farm reward token.
Admin-only manual injection of external farming rewards into extRewardPerShare.
Admin-only toggle that approves, deposits into or withdraws from the external sushi farm.
Admin-only binding of a WanFarm pool to an external sushi farm pid.
Admin-only function disabling the external claim flag when external deposits are disabled.
Internal safe transfer of wanWan capped by the contract balance.
Internal accrual routine updating accwanWanPerShare and lastRewardBlock.
Internal block-count multiplier used for reward accrual.
View function computing pending wanWan rewards for a user.
View function computing pending external sushi rewards for a user.
View function summing unclaimed external rewards across all pools bound to one external farm.
Internal routine that deposits LP into the external farm and pays out sushi to msg.sender.
Internal routine that withdraws LP from the external farm and pays out sushi to msg.sender.
Low-level delegatecall from the UniFarm fallback into wanFarmImplementation using arbitrary msg.data.
External call to ISushiChef.deposit that transfers control to a user-supplied farm contract.
External call to ISushiChef.withdraw/emergencyWithdraw handing control to the external farm.
ERC20 transfer of wanWan or sushi reward tokens to msg.sender or _to prior to full accounting.
deposit _pid pool index parameter.
deposit _amount LP amount parameter.
Local pending reward amount computed in deposit/withdraw before the token transfer.
withdraw _amount LP amount parameter.
quitwanWan _to recipient parameter.

edges.reason: Constructors assign admin from msg.sender.
Any caller can trigger the payable fallback.
Caller identity is compared against admin to stage an implementation.
Caller identity is compared against pendingWanFarmImplementation.
Caller identity is compared against admin to stage an admin.
Caller identity is compared against pendingAdmin.
_become gate depends entirely on msg.sender being the uniFarm admin.
deposit is publicly callable by any address.
withdraw is publicly callable by any address.
emergencyWithdraw is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
quitwanWan is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
quitExtFarm is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
distributeFinalExtReward is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
enableDoubleFarming is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
setDoubleFarming is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
disableExtEnableClaim is protected by onlyOwner(admin).
Fallback reads wanFarmImplementation as delegatecall target.
Fallback delegates arbitrary calldata into the implementation contract.
_become reads uniFarm.admin() and trusts that address for authorization.
_become invokes _acceptImplementation on the supplied UniFarm instance.
Staged implementation is written into pendingWanFarmImplementation.
Accepting writes pendingWanFarmImplementation into wanFarmImplementation.
Accepting clears pendingWanFarmImplementation.
Staged admin is written into pendingAdmin.
Accepting admin writes pendingAdmin into admin.
Accepting admin clears pendingAdmin.
deposit reads and mutates PoolInfo accounting.
deposit reads and mutates the caller UserInfo entry.
deposit pays pending wanWan from the reward token contract.
deposit credits msg.sender and refunds rewards to it.
deposit first refreshes the pool via updatePool.
deposit forwards LP into the external farm helper.
pending reward is transferred to msg.sender before rewardDebt/currentSupply are finalised.
withdraw reads and mutates PoolInfo accounting.
withdraw reads and mutates the caller UserInfo entry.
withdraw pays pending wanWan from the reward token contract.
wanWan is sent to msg.sender before user.amount and currentSupply are decreased.
withdraw refreshes the pool via updatePool after the external unwind.
withdraw calls the external-farm withdrawal helper first.
Reward transfer precedes effects on user.amount/currentSupply allowing reentrant calls.
emergencyWithdraw calls ISushiChef.emergencyWithdraw on the user-bound farm.
quitwanWan reads the wanWan balance to compute the sweep amount.
quitwanWan forwards the residual balance to safewanWanTransfer.
quitwanWan updates every pool before computing residuals.
quitExtFarm queries totalUnclaimedExtFarmReward to cap the transfer.
quitExtFarm transfers the surplus sushi reward token to _to.
extRewardPerShare update divides by pool.currentSupply which may be zero.
distributeFinalExtReward computes outstanding liabilities before capping.
enableDoubleFarming calls the external farm deposit with pool liquidity.
enableDoubleFarming calls the external farm withdraw to unwind liquidity.
setDoubleFarming reads and writes the pool external farm metadata.
disableExtEnableClaim mutates the pool external claim flag.
safewanWanTransfer executes the actual wanWan transfer capped by balance.
updatePool updates accwanWanPerShare and lastRewardBlock.
updatePool uses getMultiplier to compute the reward under accrual.
getMultiplier reads pool start/end and lastRewardBlock fields.
pendingwanWan reads PoolInfo accrual fields.
pendingwanWan reads the user reward debt for the pool.
pendingExtReward reads external farm metadata of the pool.
pendingExtReward reads the user external reward debt.
totalUnclaimedExtFarmReward iterates poolInfo accumulator values.
depositLPToSuShiChef calls ISushiChef.deposit forwarding user LP tokens.
Sushi reward is transferred to msg.sender before extRewardDebt is updated.
withDrawLPFromSuShi calls ISushiChef.withdraw before user state is settled.
Sushi reward is transferred to msg.sender before the extRewardDebt effect.
deposit pool index parameter feeds poolInfo lookup.
deposit amount parameter feeds LP accounting.
The pending local value determines the amount moved by the token transfer.
withdraw amount parameter feeds LP accounting.
quitwanWan recipient parameter receives the swept wanWan.

normalization_plan.reason: deposit's _pid parameter only exists to index poolInfo inside deposit and folds into the deposit function node.
deposit's _amount parameter is consumed exclusively by deposit accounting and folds into the deposit function node.
The local pending reward variable is only an intermediate feeding the reward token transfer unsafe operation.
withdraw's _amount parameter is consumed exclusively by withdraw accounting and folds into the withdraw function node.
quitwanWan's _to parameter is the recipient of the sweep executed inside quitwanWan.
